name: method-ouro-adamw
preserved: A shared linear gate defines tokenwise conditional halting hazards; the final exit receives all remaining survival probability.
Training minimizes sum_r p_r*CE_r minus beta*H(p), with full gradients through the gate, backbone and unique head.
Every visit is executed; terminal logits provide common fixed-depth evaluation and generation.
adaptations: Shared gate weights and bias start at zero; the entropy coefficient is an explicit public-stack choice.
Each visit reads through the common final norm and unique output head, with no independent coda.
Stage II, token-level early exit and missing-KV strategies are outside this selected path.
Publicly reconstructible DCLM replaces the original private corpus; the frozen manifest and tokenizer are separate comparison identities.
Common RMSNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU cells, softmax top-k with selected-weight normalization and dropless dispatch.
Track P2's AdamW and independently owned input embedding/output head; no original-paper quality or scaling claim.

Geometry: width 640 (5 heads of 128) instead of P2's 1280, because the expected-CE readout at each of the 3 visits projects onto the 151669-token vocabulary three times per token and only half of P2's width fits m0's training FLOPs; 4 core layers instead of 2 give m0's 12 logical layers (4 x 3), experts of width 304 fill the FLOPs and 562 experts per layer meet m0's unique parameters; so the vocabulary readout is 74% of its training FLOPs (m0: 37%), its other compute is 41% of m0's, and top-8 of 562 experts activates 1.4% of them (m0: 12.5%).

Matrix initialization std=.02 and unit norm scales are P2's; seq 4096, 1,048,576 positions per update, the schedule (95-update linear warmup, constant peak, last 20% linear to 0) and the AdamW or Muon settings are Track P2's; the training recipe (objective, depth, aux coefficient, expert LR multiplier) is the constructor's.
